scope: Curated primary sources; tool/runtime compatibility is separately tested.

items.name: Anthropic frontend-design
items.why_selected: Baseline art-direction and design critique; a literal snapshot is included.
items.caveat: Do not let a generic aesthetic rule override the specific product brief.

items.name: Impeccable
items.why_selected: Opinionated craft, critique and deterministic frontend design audit tooling.
items.caveat: The reviewed README describes one skill, 24 commands and 61 detector rules. Launcher can download a native engine; review/pin, do not treat as passive text only.

items.name: Vercel agent-skills
items.why_selected: React architecture/performance, web guidelines and composition patterns.
items.caveat: Select relevant skills; deployment tools are not authorized by this collection. Resolve complete dependent files and per-skill terms.
items.license_note: README license claim; inspect exact selected tree before vendoring

items.name: CloudAI-X Three.js skills
items.why_selected: Ten topic-specific Three.js skill references for geometry, lighting, materials, loaders and interactions.
items.caveat: Reviewed README install example points at a different repository. License was claimed as MIT but a discrete license file was not established. Reference-only here; do not blindly copy its installer.
items.license_note: MIT claimed in README; redistribution not independently cleared here

items.name: Blender command-line manual
items.why_selected: Headless Python jobs, explicit process arguments and failure exit codes.
items.caveat: Full document fetch failed in this research environment; indexed command documentation was available. Probe installed version and options.

items.name: Blender glTF import/export manual
items.why_selected: Native-to-browser material/export constraints and supported glTF features.
items.caveat: Full fetch unavailable; canonical manual link plus partial index only. Test the installed exporter.

items.name: Community MCP for Blender
items.why_selected: Optional live scene inspection/manipulation bridge.
items.caveat: Third party, not Blender Foundation. Arbitrary Python execution and telemetry enabled by default. Hosted generation integrations are not offline.
items.license_note: MIT repository plus separate terms/telemetry disclosures; review selected revision

items.name: Three.js documentation
items.why_selected: Primary renderer, loaders, materials, cameras and WebGPU/TSL API reference.
items.caveat: Use documentation matching the exact installed release; a dev branch version is not evidence of an npm stable release.
items.license_note: Three.js software MIT; consult upstream source

items.name: React Three Fiber scaling performance
items.why_selected: On-demand rendering, reuse, instancing and React scene performance.
items.caveat: Demand loops still need invalidation while a spring or control settles. React is not a prerequisite for 3D.

items.name: GSAP ScrollTrigger
items.why_selected: Complex synchronized scroll progress, pinned sections and timeline control.
items.caveat: Use one transform owner and teardown cleanly; respect current GSAP license.
items.license_note: GSAP custom standard license; NOT MIT

items.name: Motion scroll
items.why_selected: A lean alternative for scroll-linked DOM and JS progress callbacks.
items.caveat: Separate free/public runtime APIs from paid Motion+ resources; do not bundle a paid AI kit.
items.license_note: Runtime/source and paid resources have distinct terms

items.name: CSS animation-timeline
items.why_selected: Native scroll/view timelines for DOM/SVG effects where supported.
items.caveat: Feature-detect and retain baseline content; not a replacement for the 3D renderer.

items.name: Lenis
items.why_selected: Optional smooth-scroll orchestration when native scrolling demonstrably needs it.
items.caveat: Not the default. Do not install a second competing RAF or break touch/reduced-motion behavior.
items.license_note: Check exact revision license before embedding

items.name: model-viewer
items.why_selected: Simpler product viewing, posters, camera controls and supported AR paths.
items.caveat: Use before building a custom scene when the interaction is just product inspection.

items.name: Rive web runtime
items.why_selected: Vector/state-machine active illustrations, controls and meaningful input-driven motion.
items.caveat: Editable .riv authoring and runtime are different concerns; file and editor rights need review.

items.name: glTF Transform CLI
items.why_selected: Inspect and optimize glTF assets through explicit transformations.
items.caveat: Do not run arbitrary flatten/join/prune recipes that delete nodes needed by interactions.
items.license_note: MIT software; consult exact dependency lock

items.name: Khronos glTF Validator
items.why_selected: Independent standards validation of delivered glTF/GLB.
items.caveat: The kit Python audit is narrower and is not a substitute.

items.name: F3D
items.why_selected: Independent local asset inspection and supported screenshot workflows.
items.caveat: Verify formats/render backend on the actual worker; do not equate successful import with artistic quality.

items.name: Poly Haven asset license
items.why_selected: HDRIs, textures and models for local look development with asset provenance.
items.caveat: CC0 asset licensing does not grant trademark rights or relicense all site code/content. Nothing downloaded automatically.
items.license_note: CC0 assets under published asset policy

items.name: ambientCG
items.why_selected: Alternative PBR material library for an approved local texture cache.
items.caveat: The license page could not be fetched during this run. Recheck the actual item and license before download/use.
items.license_note: Unverified in this run; no assets bundled

items.name: React Three Rapier
items.why_selected: Physics for genuinely manipulable objects and collisions.
items.caveat: Avoid a physics dependency for an ordinary deterministic scroll orbit.
items.license_note: Check exact release license and dependencies

items.name: Playwright visual comparisons
items.why_selected: Browser screenshots and reproducible interaction checks.
items.caveat: Use stable viewport/state and readiness assertions; image diffs alone are not semantic correctness.

items.name: Hunyuan3D-2.1
items.why_selected: Optional local image-to-3D shape and PBR texture generation.
items.caveat: Published VRAM: 10 GB shape, 21 GB texture, 29 GB combined. Hardware/backend/build compatibility must be verified.
items.license_note: Custom code/weight/model terms require review; not blanket MIT

items.name: TRELLIS.2
items.why_selected: Optional high-capacity local image-to-3D workflow.
items.caveat: Primary model card lists Linux-tested NVIDIA >=24 GB. Not a promise of Apple Metal support or foreground-coexistence.
items.license_note: MIT shown for repository; verify weights/dependency terms separately

items.name: Agent Skills specification
items.why_selected: Interoperable SKILL.md metadata and progressive loading.
items.caveat: A format standard does not install tools or make untrusted instructions safe.

items.name: Codex skills documentation
items.why_selected: Project/shared skill discovery and duplicate-name behavior.
items.caveat: Use upstream documentation only as a starting point for the user's forks; verify installed discovery.

items.name: ForgeCode skills documentation
items.why_selected: Project .forge/skills and shared skill discovery.
items.caveat: Verify actual local fork and permissions; do not overwrite existing configuration.

items.name: Blender Lab MCP server
items.why_selected: Official Blender Lab experimental MCP direction, distinct from community integrations.
items.caveat: Indexed primary page available; full fetch failed. Installation/protocol not runtime verified here. Arbitrary-code risks still apply.

items.name: UI UX Pro Max
items.why_selected: Broad style/pattern exploration as an optional source of alternatives.
items.caveat: Do not treat a large palette/style database as a 3D authoring or visual quality guarantee.
items.license_note: Review exact selected revision license before collecting files

items.name: Anthropic webapp-testing
items.why_selected: External Playwright workflow reference.
items.caveat: Not bundled. It references helper scripts; fetching only SKILL.md is incomplete. Its blanket networkidle guidance is not suitable for every continuously connected app; use application readiness.
items.license_note: Inspect per-skill license and complete dependency files

items.name: Codrops Creative Hub
items.why_selected: Find first-party creative studios and implementation references.
items.caveat: Reference composition and behavior, not unauthorized copying of artwork.

items.name: Codrops cinematic 3D scroll tutorial
items.why_selected: A relevant worked example of cinematic 3D scroll composition.
items.caveat: Title/date indexed from creator site; article fetch timed out. Inspect code and rights before reuse.

items.name: Codrops scroll tutorial index
items.why_selected: A discoverable set of scroll-linked design experiments.
items.caveat: A visual inspiration index is not an endorsement of every implementation or license.

items.name: GSAP standard license
items.why_selected: Current license reference for GSAP use and redistribution.
items.caveat: Free availability should not be paraphrased as no license restrictions.

items.name: TRELLIS.2 model card
items.why_selected: Primary model requirements and usage context.
items.caveat: Read model card and associated license before acquiring multi-GB weights.

items.name: Blender Python API export operators
items.why_selected: Exact installed exporter operator and argument documentation.
items.caveat: Full web fetch failed; probe local operator RNA before accepting an unfamiliar export flag.
